prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man with fair skin and light brown hair sits indoors, facing slightly to the right of the camera in a medium close-up shot. He wears round black glasses, a dark green overshirt, and a light gray t-shirt underneath. His expression is calm and attentive, as if he is engaged in a thoughtful conversation or interview. The background is softly blurred, revealing a cozy, warmly lit room with wooden shelves filled with books and a leafy green potted plant, creating a sense of depth and homeliness. The color palette is warm and natural, with earthy browns, greens, and soft ambient lighting that gives the scene a gentle, inviting atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the subject, while the background remains pleasantly out of focus, enhancing the intimate, cinematic quality of the image.
